scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Just one second.
You're carrying too
many items with you
right now, so you better
place some of your things
into Kafra Storage, yes?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
請稍等。
您身上攜帶的物品太多了，
最好把一些東西存進卡普拉倉庫，
您說呢？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Excuse me, monsieur?
Yes, you. If you're not
here as hired help for the
kitchen, then I'd like to
ask you to leave now.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
打擾一下，先生？
對，就是你。如果你不是來廚房
做幫工的，那我建議你立刻離開。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Please don't be
offended, but I can't
concentrate on my 
cooking when Novices
like yourself are running
around here like children.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
請別介意，但像你這樣的初心者
在這裡像孩子一樣跑來跑去，
讓我無法專心烹飪。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Mademoiselle, what
are you doing in this
area of the castle?
Oh, you must be lost~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
小姐，您在這座城堡的
這個區域做什麼呢？
哦，您一定是迷路了~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Please, use the stairs
to the right to exit into the
main structure. My dear,
be careful and watch your
step when you climb up
the stairs for me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
請走右邊的樓梯
到主樓去。親愛的，
爬樓梯的時候請小心腳下，
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Monsieur, why you look
at me so? Is it the Morocc
silk shirt I am wearing, my
hair styled by Madam Veronica,
or my brand name muffler
refined by Monsieur Antonio?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
先生，您為什麼這樣看著我？
是因為我穿著摩洛哥絲綢襯衫，
還是因為維羅妮卡女士為我打理的髮型，
亦或是安東尼奧先生為我挑選的名牌圍巾？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Perhaps you are in awe
of the latest, fashionable
spectacles that was designed
by the artists from the Rekenber Corporation? Please, do tell~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
也許您是被雷肯貝爾公司
設計師設計的最新時尚眼鏡
所折服了？請告訴我~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Wait, wait just a
moment. Do you know
anything about the latest
trends? You don't seem
to be very fashionable...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
等等，請稍等。
您瞭解最新的潮流嗎？
您看起來似乎不太時尚...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ugh, if I can avoid it,
I usually prefer not to
associate with ruffians.
But I do find that you
adventurers do have
your strong points...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
唉，如果可以的話，
我通常不喜歡和粗魯的人打交道。
但我發現你們冒險者
確實有你們獨特的優點...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh! Pardon the squalor
of my humble kitchen,
Mademoiselle. But even
the splendor of the Prontera
Castle pales to the radiance
of your captivating beauty.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
哦！請原諒我這簡陋廚房的
雜亂無章，小姐。但即使是普隆德拉
城堡的輝煌，在您迷人的美貌
面前也顯得黯然失色。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Tell me, who is the
lovely child holding
the cat right next to you?
I know it is rude to ask,
but I am emboldened by
my, shall we say, curiosity.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
告訴我，您旁邊那個
抱著貓的可愛孩子是誰？
我知道這樣問很失禮，
但我被一種，姑且稱之為好奇心
的東西驅使著。

scripts.text: She is my sister
scripts.translation: 她是我的妹妹

scripts.text: Actually, I don't know her.
scripts.translation: 其實，我不認識她。

scripts.text:
[The kid with a cat]
Nyahahaha,
Nyahahaha~
Meow~ Meow~
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
呀哈哈哈，
呀哈哈哈~
喵~ 喵~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
What a lovely child.
Be quiet like a good girl.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
真是個可愛的孩子。
乖一點，安靜些。

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
...Nya?
...Meow?
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
...喵？
...喵？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
She is lovely and
quite although she
doesn't look like you.
Even her cat looks adorable.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
她既可愛又安靜，
雖然看起來不像您。
連她的貓看起來都很可愛。

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Nyahahaha,
Nyahahaha~
Meow, meow~
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
呀哈哈哈，
呀哈哈哈~
喵，喵~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, again, let me
apologize. I had believed
that this child was fortunate
enough to be a companion
of the mademoiselle.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
啊，再次向您致歉。
我原以為這個孩子很幸運，
能成為小姐的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Allow me to introduce
myself to you, amour.
I am your ever faithful
servant whose heart is
enraptured by your gaze.
My name is Charles Orleans.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
請允許我向您介紹自己，親愛的。
我是您永遠忠誠的僕人，
我的心早已為您的目光所傾倒。
我的名字是查爾斯·奧爾良。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Yet there is one thing that
anguishes me. Ever since his
highness, King Tristram III,
has vanished, I have found no
one worthy of tasting my wares.
My life now lacks meaning...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
然而有一件事讓我痛苦不已。
自從特里斯坦三世陛下失蹤後，
我就再也沒找到配得上品嚐我佳餚的人了。
我的生活如今失去了意義...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Alas, recently I have been
reduced to teaching mere
apprentices, tyros in the
culinary arts, my skills.
It is frustrating--many of
them do not have any talent!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
唉，最近我不得不
教一些毫無天賦的學徒，
這些烹飪藝術的初學者。
這真讓人沮喪——
他們中很多人完全沒有天賦！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, forgive me, dear
Mademoiselle. I hope you
understand the difficulty
I am forced to suffer. When
next we meet, I would very much like to give you a sweet dessert.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
啊，請原諒我，
可愛的小姐。希望您能理解
我被迫忍受的困境。
下次見面時，我非常想
為您準備一份甜蜜的甜點。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Yes, women with your
beauty definitely deserve
the luscious flavors of the
treats that only I can offer.
Until that day comes, I shall
reluctantly bid you adieu.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
是的，擁有您這般美貌的女性，
絕對值得品嚐只有我能提供的
美味佳餚。在那天到來之前，
我不得不依依不捨地向您告辭。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, have you come here
to learn cooking? ^333333*Sigh*^000000
I don't feel like teaching
anything today--in fact,
I think teaching is a waste
of my time! ^333333*Sigh*^000000 However...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
哦，你是來學烹飪的嗎？^333333*嘆氣*^000000
我今天不想教任何東西——
事實上，我覺得教學是浪費時間！^333333*嘆氣*^000000 不過...

scripts.text: Um, are you talking to me?
scripts.translation: 呃，你在跟我說話嗎？

scripts.text: Wait, don't you remember me?
scripts.translation: 等等，你不記得我了嗎？

scripts.text: Sir Orleans?
scripts.translation: 奧爾良先生？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Who else would
I be talking to?
To Madeleine over
there? Or that child
holding that mangy
cat? Sacrebleu!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
我還能跟誰說話？
跟那邊的瑪德琳？
還是那個抱著一隻髒兮兮貓的孩子？
該死！

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Grrrrrrr!
Rrrroreow!
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
嗚嗚嗚！
喵嗚！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Goodness, you scared me!
What an ill natured kid!
Who brought this kid in?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
天哪，嚇我一跳！
這孩子脾氣真差！
是誰把這孩子帶進來的？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I can't remember every
tyro who's begged me for
instruction in the culinary
arts. I could swear you've
come here months ago, it's
just--what was your name...?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
我記不清每一個
求我傳授烹飪技藝的學徒了。
我敢打賭你幾個月前就來了，
只是——你叫什麼名字來著...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Bah! No matter.
I suppose that's
of no importance
at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
算了，無所謂。
我想這現在
並不重要。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
E-excuse me? I may be
your instructor, but you
can call me by my first name.
I know that I can be strict,
but please: in the end, we are colleagues, even if I am superior.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
呃...請原諒？我雖然
是你的導師，但你可以
直接叫我的名字。
我知道我可能很嚴格，
但請聽我說：歸根結底，我們是同事，
即使我是上級。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Fine, fine...
If you insist on your
modicum of expressed
respect, then you may
call me ''Sir Charles.''
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
好吧，好吧...
如果你堅持要表達
那一點尊重，
那你可以叫我“查爾斯先生”。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah... That does have
a rather fine ring to it.
I actually earned that title
from the king himself, even
if I'm a knight only in title and manner, rather than strength.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
啊...這聽起來
確實很順口。
這個頭銜其實是國王親自授予我的，
即使我只在頭銜和舉止上是騎士，
而非在實力上。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Well then, let's get started
today with making a simple
dish. Okay, ^FF0000I don't teach recipes
more than once^000000, ^FF0000so make sure
that you write this down^000000. Now
then, what shall we cook?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
那麼，讓我們今天
從做一道簡單的菜開始吧。好的，^FF0000我不會重複教食譜^000000，^FF0000所以請確保你把它記下來^000000。
那麼，我們要做什麼菜？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ahhh, how about
'Fried Grasshopper Legs?'
To the uninitiated, it may
seem to be a disgusting dish,
but trust me, its exquisite taste is pure pleasure for your palate.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
啊哈，怎麼樣，
“油炸螞蚱”？
對於外行來說，這可能
看起來是一道令人反感的菜，
但相信我，它 exquisite 的味道
是味蕾的純粹享受。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Now, please bring
^4D4DFF5 Grasshopper Legs^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Cooking Oil^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Old Frying Pan^000000.
Then, we can begin.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
現在，請帶來
^4D4DFF5 螞蚱^000000、
^4D4DFF1 食用油^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1 破舊平底鍋^000000。
然後，我們就可以開始了。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, I've got it!
Let's make ''Grape Juice
Herbal Tea.'' The weather
is perfect right now for
a cool, refreshing drink.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
啊，我想到了！
讓我們做“葡萄汁草本茶”吧。現在的天氣
非常適合來一杯清涼解渴的飲料。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Please bring
^4D4DFF3 Grapes^000000, and
^4D4DFF2 Red Potions^000000
so that we can
begin the lesson~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
請帶來
^4D4DFF3葡萄^000000，以及
^4D4DFF2紅色藥水^000000，
這樣我們就可以開始上課了~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I've got it~
We can make
''Honey Grape Juice.''
Please bring me the
following ingredients so
that we can begin the lesson.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
我想到了~
我們可以做
“蜂蜜葡萄汁”。
請帶來以下材料，
這樣我們就可以開始上課了。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
^4D4DFF1 Honey^000000,
^4D4DFF2 Grapes^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Red Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
^4D4DFF1蜂蜜^000000、
^4D4DFF2葡萄^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1紅色藥水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Mmm, why don't we
make ''Frog Egg and
Squid Ink Soup?'' Those
bereft of gourmet taste may
think it's disgusting, but it's
actually quite scrumptious.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
嗯，我們為什麼不做
“蛙卵墨汁湯”呢？那些
缺乏美食鑑賞力的人可能會
覺得它很噁心，但它其實
非常美味。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Well then,
please bring me
^4D4DFF1 Bag of Grain^000000,
^4D4DFF10 Spawns^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Squid Ink^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
那麼，
請帶來
^4D4DFF1穀物袋^000000、
^4D4DFF10蛙卵^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1墨汁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, I know what
would be perfect right
now. ''Steamed Crab
Nippers.'' Now, please
bring these ingredients
so we can make this soup.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
啊，我知道現在
什麼最完美了。“蒸蟹鉗”。
現在，請帶來這些材料，
這樣我們就可以做這道湯了。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
We'll need
^4D4DFF10 Green Herbs^000000,
^4D4DFF10 Nippers^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
我們需要
^4D4DFF10綠色藥草^000000、
^4D4DFF10蟹鉗^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1黃色藥水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ooh, you know what
would be scrumptious?
''Fried Monkey Tails.'' Yes,
that sounds perfect! Please
bring these ingredients so
that I can teach you this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
噢，你知道什麼
會非常美味嗎？
“熱炒猴尾巴”。是的，
聽起來很完美！請帶來這些材料，
這樣我就可以教你這道菜了。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
We'll need
^4D4DFF1 Frying Pan^000000,
^4D4DFF5 Yoyo Tails^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Cooking Oil^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
我們需要
^4D4DFF1平底鍋^000000、
^4D4DFF5溜溜猴尾巴^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1食用油^000000。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Finally, you're here! Never
forget: your ingredients must
always be as fresh as possible.
If not, your cuisine will be much poorer in quality. Now, let me
explain how to make this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
終於來了！永遠記住：你的材料
必須儘可能新鮮。
如果不新鮮，你的料理質量
就會大打折扣。現在，讓我
解釋一下如何製作這道菜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Scrub the Grasshopper Legs
as cleanly as you can before
placing them in the Frying Pan.
Afterwards, pour half a bottle of Cooking Oil and fry the legs at
high heat for about 20 minutes.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
把螞蚱腿儘可能
清洗乾淨，然後放入平底鍋。
之後，倒入半瓶食用油，
用大火炸大約20分鐘。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Now, follow the instructions
that I've just given you to the
letter! Hmmm... Good, good.
That's not bad at all. Alright,
you're almost there...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
現在，請嚴格按照
我剛才給你的指示去做！嗯...很好，很好。
這還不錯。好的，
你快成功了...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There, you're done!
The presentation can use
a little work, but at least you
know this recipe now. That's
all for today, so please go
and practice on your own now.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
好了，完成了！
擺盤還可以再改進一下，但至少你
已經掌握這個食譜了。今天就到這裡，
請去自己練習一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Hurry and bring me
the ingredients to make
Fried Grasshopper Legs!
If a restaurant patron had
ordered this, then you'd
already be making him wait!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
快點把做油炸螞蚱的
材料帶來！
如果有餐廳客人點了這道菜，
那你已經在讓他等待了！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Just go and ambush those
happy-go-lucky grasshoppers
just playing in the fields. Hurry and smash them, then rip their
legs off--but be humane about it!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
只要去埋伏那些
在田野裡無憂無慮玩耍的螞蚱。
快點打倒它們，然後撕下它們的腿——
但要人道一點！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Finally, you're here! Never
forget: your ingredients must
always be as fresh as possible.
If not, your cuisine will be much poorer in quality. Now, let me
explain how to make this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
終於來了！永遠記住：你的材料
必須儘可能新鮮。
如果不新鮮，你的料理質量
就會大打折扣。現在，讓我
解釋一下如何製作這道菜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You extract the juice
from the Grapes like this--
we can't use pre-made Grape
Juice for the sake of freshness. Then, you need to boil the Red
Potions in a bain-marie...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
像這樣從葡萄中
榨出汁液——為了新鮮度，
我們不能使用現成的葡萄汁。然後，你需要
用隔水加熱法煮沸紅色藥水...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
When the Red Potions
reach the right consistency,
gently stir in the juice that you just squeezed from the Grapes.
Now, I want you to try it. Hmm... That's not bad... Good, good...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
當紅色藥水
達到合適的稠度時，
輕輕攪拌你剛從葡萄中榨出的汁液。
現在，我想讓你嚐嚐。嗯...還不錯...很好，很好...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There, you're done!
The presentation can use
a little work, but at least you
know this recipe now. That's
all for today, so please go
and practice on your own now.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
好了，完成了！
擺盤還可以再改進一下，但至少你
已經掌握這個食譜了。今天就到這裡，
請去自己練習一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
What are you doing?
Hurry and bring me the
ingredients for Grape Juice
Herbal Tea! At a real restaurant, you'd never be able to take your
time like this! Quickly, now!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
你在做什麼？
快點把做葡萄汁草本茶的
材料帶來！在真正的餐廳裡，你
絕對不可能像這樣慢慢吞吞！快點，現在！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Having trouble finding
Grapes? Just pop open
those cute little Poporings...
Of course, you should try to
be humane when you hunt them...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
找不到葡萄？
只要開啟那些可愛的波波利...
當然，你在狩獵它們的時候
應該儘量人道一點...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Finally, you're here! Never
forget: your ingredients must
always be as fresh as possible.
If not, your cuisine will be much poorer in quality. Now, let me
explain how to make this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
終於來了！永遠記住：你的材料
必須儘可能新鮮。
如果不新鮮，你的料理質量
就會大打折扣。現在，讓我
解釋一下如何製作這道菜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
First, skin the Grapes
and extract the seeds. Then,
blend the Grapes with the
Honey. Take this blended
mixture and carefully stir
it into the Red Potion...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
首先，剝去葡萄皮並取出籽。然後，
將葡萄與蜂蜜混合。取這份混合液，
小心地將其攪拌進紅色藥水中...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
When the pulp is fully
mixed into the Red Potion,
you'll be finished. Now, go
and try making it yourself.
Right, that's good. Yes...
Wait, wait! Okay, there you go~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
當果肉完全融入紅色藥水後，
就完成了。現在，去試著做一下。
很好，不錯。是的...
等等，等等！好了，就是這樣~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There, you're done!
The presentation can use
a little work, but at least you
know this recipe now. That's
all for today, so please go
and practice on your own now.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
好了，完成了！
擺盤還可以再改進一下，但至少你
已經掌握這個食譜了。今天就到這裡，
請去自己練習一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
What's taking you so
long? You should have
brought me the ingredients
to make Honey Grape Juice
a while ago. Hurry it up!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
你怎麼這麼慢？
你應該早就把做蜂蜜葡萄汁的
材料帶來了。快點！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You're having trouble
finding some Honey for the
Honey Grape Juice, aren't you?
Just go and hunt some bears,
they're always carrying some
of that Honey around.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
你是在找蜂蜜做蜂蜜葡萄汁
遇到困難了嗎？
去獵殺一些熊吧，
它們身上總是帶著一些蜂蜜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Finally, you're here! Never
forget: your ingredients must
always be as fresh as possible.
If not, your cuisine will be much poorer in quality. Now, let me
explain how to make this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
終於來了！永遠記住：你的材料
必須儘可能新鮮。
如果不新鮮，你的料理質量
就會大打折扣。現在，讓我
解釋一下如何製作這道菜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Mill the grain until
it's a fine flour, then
boil the Squid Ink at
medium heat. Once it
bubbles, pour in the flour.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
將穀物磨成細粉，然後
用中火煮沸墨汁。一旦
開始冒泡，就倒入麵粉。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Keep stirring, slowly
adding the Spawns. When
it all boils again, reduce the
heat and simmer for about 10
minutes. Okay, now you try it.
That's good, good... Alright~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
繼續攪拌，慢慢加入蛙卵。
當再次沸騰時，調小火
燉煮約10分鐘。好了，現在你來試試。
很好，不錯... 好吧~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There, you're done!
The presentation can use
a little work, but at least you
know this recipe now. That's
all for today, so please go
and practice on your own now.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
好了，完成了！
擺盤還可以再改進一下，但至少你
已經掌握這個食譜了。今天就到這裡，
請去自己練習一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
What are you doing?
You're supposed to be
preparing ingredients
for Frog Egg and Squid
Ink Soup right now!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
你在做什麼？
你現在應該正在準備
蛙卵墨汁湯的材料！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You have to be careful
when you're handling Frog
Eggs. If you feed them raw to
somebody, well, their flavor is
decidely less than magnifique.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
處理蛙卵時要小心。
如果你生吃給別人，
嗯，味道肯定不太美妙。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Finally, you're here! Never
forget: your ingredients must
always be as fresh as possible.
If not, your cuisine will be much poorer in quality. Now, let me
explain how to make this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
終於來了！永遠記住：你的材料
必須儘可能新鮮。
如果不新鮮，你的料理質量
就會大打折扣。現在，讓我
解釋一下如何製作這道菜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Boil the Nippers in Yellow
Potion on low heat for about
30 minutes. Then, bring it down
to a simmer and carefully stir
in the Green Herbs one by one.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
將蟹鉗放入黃色藥水中，
用小火煮約30分鐘。然後，
轉小火慢燉，並小心地
逐一加入綠色藥草。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
This is an easy recipe, but
I still want you to demonstrate
for me. Okay, let's see now...
You're doing fine. Now, wait...
Good, good, okay, it's ready
for the Green Herbs now...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
這是一個簡單的食譜，
但我還是想讓你演示一下。
好的，讓我看看...
你做得不錯。現在，等一下...
很好，不錯，好了，現在可以
加入綠色藥草了...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There, you're done!
The presentation can use
a little work, but at least you
know this recipe now. That's
all for today, so please go
and practice on your own now.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
好了，完成了！
擺盤還可以再改進一下，但至少你
已經掌握這個食譜了。今天就到這裡，
請去自己練習一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Shouldn't you be
preparing all of the
ingredients for Steamed
Crab Nippers? You need
to work quickly for those
hungry restaurant patrons!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
你不應該正在準備
清蒸蟹鉗的所有材料嗎？
為了那些飢餓的餐廳顧客，
你需要動作快點！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
It shouldn't be too hard
to gather Nippers. Just
find some Vadons and crush
them, making sure to rip off
their Nippers. That sounds strange, I know, but just do it.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
收集蟹鉗不應該太難。
只要找到一些螃蟹，
把它們壓碎，確保撕下
它們的蟹鉗。我知道這聽起來很奇怪，
但照做就是了。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Finally, you're here! Never
forget: your ingredients must
always be as fresh as possible.
If not, your cuisine will be much poorer in quality. Now, let me
explain how to make this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
終於來了！永遠記住：你的材料
必須儘可能新鮮。
如果不新鮮，你的料理質量
就會大打折扣。現在，讓我
解釋一下如何製作這道菜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Pluck the hair from the
tails and rinse them well
under cold water. Pour half
a bottle of Cooking Oil unto
a preheated pan, and then
quickly fry the tails.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
拔掉尾巴上的毛，並在冷水下
沖洗乾淨。在預熱的鍋中倒入
半瓶食用油，然後
快速煎炸尾巴。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
The trick is to fry the
tails quickly without burning
them, so you'll probably want
to cook using medium-high heat.
Show me what you've learned now... Alright, that's not bad... Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
訣竅是快速煎炸尾巴而不燒焦，
所以你可能想用中高火烹飪。
現在展示一下你學到的... 好吧，還不錯... 嗯...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There, you're done!
The presentation can use
a little work, but at least you
know this recipe now. That's
all for today, so please go
and practice on your own now.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
好了，完成了！
擺盤還可以再改進一下，但至少你
已經掌握這個食譜了。今天就到這裡，
請去自己練習一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You better go prepare
those ingredients for Fried
Monkey Tails are quickly as
you can. In a real restaurant,
you'd never able to take your
time like this. Toute allure!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
你最好儘快去準備
炸猴尾的材料。在真正的餐廳裡，
你絕對不可能像這樣慢慢吞吞。Toute allure!

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You need more tails?
Just sneak up on some
Yoyos, swiftly kill them,
and then slice off their tails.
You're a beginner, but I won't
allow you to be inhumane!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
你需要更多尾巴？
只要悄悄接近一些溜溜猴，
迅速殺死它們，
然後切下它們的尾巴。
你是個新手，但我不會允許你
不人道地對待它們！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh... I'm so exhausted!
I have too much wisdom and
skills to pass on! Teaching is
not an endeavor I enjoy, but
I do realize it is necessary
for my cuisine to survive me...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
哦... 我太累了！
我有太多的智慧和技能
要傳授！教學並不是
我喜歡的活動，但我意識到
這是為了讓我的料理在我之後
得以延續...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Peser le bien et le mal...
Even though it pains me,
I suppose I have to continue
teaching until one of you can
become a worthy successor.
It will take some time...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
Peser le bien et le mal...
雖然這很痛苦，
我想我必須繼續教學，
直到你們中有人能成為
合格的接班人。
這需要一些時間...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Strange, strange...
What is that kid and
that cat doing here?
The kitchen is no place
for them--at the very least,
not for pets, you know.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
奇怪，奇怪...
那個小孩和那隻貓
在這裡做什麼？
廚房不是他們的地方——
至少，寵物是不允許的，你知道嗎。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Pardon moi, child,
but would you remove
yourself and your cat
from the premises? This
is a kitchen, and everything
here needs to be clean!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
Pardon moi, 孩子，
但你能不能帶著你的貓
離開這裡？這是廚房，
這裡的一切都需要保持乾淨！

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
...Nyaaa?
...Meow?
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
...喵？
...喵？

scripts.text: What's your name, kid?
scripts.translation: 你叫什麼名字，小孩？

scripts.text: Do you want to eat something?
scripts.translation: 你想吃點東西嗎？

scripts.text: Here, kitty~
scripts.translation: 這裡，小貓咪~

scripts.text: Get out!
scripts.translation: 滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Nyaaa~
nyaaa~
(Purrrrrr)
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
喵~
喵~
（呼嚕呼嚕）

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
.....Who told you
to ask her name?
You don't even understand what she is saying.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
.....誰讓你問她名字的？
你甚至聽不懂她在說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Nyaaaa~
(Purrrrrr~)
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
喵~
（呼嚕呼嚕~）

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
That was a good idea...
Offering them food to get
them to leave. Mon dieu, if
the child won't talk to us...
Still, we need to get those
two out of the kitchen.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
這是個好主意...
給它們食物讓它們離開。天哪，
如果這孩子不肯跟我們說話...
總之，我們需要把這兩隻
趕出廚房。

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Nyahahaha~
Nyhhahaha~
(Meow, meow~)
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
喵哈哈~
喵哈哈~
（喵，喵~）

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
...Are you playing with that kid...?
...Then I don't need you to be here.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
...你在逗那個小孩玩...？
...那你不需要留在這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
...
(Meow?)
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
...
（喵？）

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Grrrrrrr!
(RRRrrreow!)
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
咕嚕嚕！
（喵嗚！）

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, look out!
You should have
been more careful
handling that cat...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
哦，小心！
你處理那隻貓的時候
應該更小心一點...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Alright, enough
is enough. We can't
continue to cook if we
have live animals in the
kitchen. It's a violation
of our sanitary standards!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
好了，夠了。
如果廚房裡有活物，
我們就沒法繼續做飯了。
這違反了我們的衛生標準！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I'm sorry, mon chere,
but you have to leave.
Child, please take your
cat and head out the door
before your feline can touch
or shed on any of the food!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
對不起，親愛的，
但你必須離開。
孩子，請帶著你的貓
從門口出去，
別讓那隻貓碰到或掉毛在
任何食物上！

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Grrrrrrr!
RRRRreow!
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
咕嚕嚕！
喵嗚！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Oh...!
Nyuyang, there
you are! What are
you doing here in
Charles's kitchen?
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
哦...！
妮揚，你在這裡！
你在查爾斯的廚房
做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
M-Madam Wickebine...!
Forgive me, you surprised
me by appearing from out
of nowhere. Do you happen
to know this young child?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
維...維克貝恩夫人...！
請原諒，你突然出現
嚇了我一跳。你認識
這個小孩嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Oh, Nyuyang here is my
little sister. It may be hard
to see the resemblance...
Anyway, I've been looking
all over for her. Are you
bothering Charles, Nyuyang?
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
哦，這裡的妮揚是
我的妹妹。可能很難看出
你們有血緣關係...
總之，我一直在找她。
妮揚，你在打擾查爾斯嗎？

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Nyuuuunyuuu~
nyuuuunyuuu~
Meooooow~
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
喵嗚~
喵嗚~
喵~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
...!!!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
...！！！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Oh, so you have
been bothering him!
You think Charles
wants you to leave?
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
哦，看來你
確實打擾到他了！
你覺得查爾斯
想讓你離開嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Hahahahah, what
are you talking about!
Nonsense! How can 
such a cute little belle
be of any trouble to me?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
哈哈哈哈哈，
你在說什麼呀！
真是胡鬧！這麼可愛
的小貝爾怎麼會打擾到我呢？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
As a matter of fact,
I was just about to treat
this precious petit and
her little cat to some
of my delicious cuisine.
So do not worry, Madam~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
事實上，
我正準備招待
這位珍貴的小貝爾
和她的小貓品嚐
我美味的料理。
所以請放心，夫人~

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Are you sure, Charles?
I know how serious you
are about your cooking,
and I don't want Nyuyang
to disturb you in any way...
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
你確定嗎，查爾斯？
我知道你對烹飪
有多認真，
我不希望妮揚
以任何方式打擾到你...

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Oh, Charles, you've
been nothing but kind
to me. I'm glad that you're
also taking care of Nyuyang.
Well then, take care~
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
哦，查爾斯，你一直
對我很好。很高興你
也在照顧妮揚。
那麼，再見~

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Nyahahaha~
Nyahahaha~
(Meow, meow~)
scripts.translation:
[抱貓的孩子]
嘻嘻哈哈~
嘻嘻哈哈~
（喵，喵~）

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
......
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
......

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah...
There goes a true
lady... Madam Wickebine...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
啊...
真是一位
真正的女士... 維克貝恩夫人...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
It's been bothering
me that his highness
has been missing for
a while. Why doesn't
anybody know where he is?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
一直困擾我的是，
陛下已經失蹤
一段時間了。為什麼
沒有人知道他在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Wise and benevolent
King Tristram III would
never abandon his subjects.
I dearly hope that nothing
serious has happened to him...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
英明仁慈的
特里斯坦三世國王
絕不會拋棄他的子民。
我衷心希望他沒有
發生什麼嚴重的事情...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Can it be possible that
our beloved king would
have enemies? He's done
nothing but good for the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
and the rest of the world!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
難道有可能
我們敬愛的國王
有敵人嗎？他為
盧恩·米德加茲王國
和世界其他地方
所做的一切都是好事！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I can't imagine a great
man like him to be in any
sort of trouble. It makes me
me laugh whenever anyone
suggests that he is hiding
in the Schwarzwald Republic...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
我無法想像像他這樣
偉大的人會陷入
任何麻煩。每當有人
暗示他躲在
修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國時，
我就忍不住發笑...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Praise the glories of the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
Long live King Tristram III!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
讚美盧恩·米德加茲王國的榮耀！
特里斯坦三世國王萬歲！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, I'm in great need of
some rest. Unless you 
have something incredibly
important to ask of me,
please let me take a break~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
哦，我很需要
休息一下。除非你有
極其重要的事情要問我，
請讓我休息一下~

scripts.text: I want to learn more recipes.
scripts.translation: 我想學習更多食譜

scripts.text: For whom do you cook?
scripts.translation: 你為誰烹飪？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to bother you...
scripts.translation: 抱歉打擾你了...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You want to learn more
recipes? I suppose that
you should borrow another
cookbook then. Before that,
please return the cookbook
that you were studying, okay?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
你想學習更多
食譜？我想你應該
再借一本食譜。在那之前，
請把你正在研究的食譜還給我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Now, choose the cookbook
that you want to borrow by
entering a level from 1 to 5.
There are more advanced books,
but I'm not lending those out.
Oh, and enter 0 to cancel.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
那麼，請輸入1到5之間的等級，
選擇你想借閱的烹飪書。
還有更高階的書，
但那些我不會外借。
哦，輸入0可以取消。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Hmm...
I asked to you to
enter a level from
1 to 5. Those are the
only cookbooks that I will
lend out to my students.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
嗯...
我讓你輸入
1到5之間的等級。
那些是我
唯一會借給
學生的烹飪書。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
So you changed your mind?
It would be a good idea to
study the recipes that you
have right now before trying
something new, I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
所以你改變主意了？
我想，在嘗試新東西之前，
先好好研究一下你現在的食譜
是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
So you wanted to borrow a
Level {0} Cookbook, eh?
Oh, would you please tell
me the level of the cookbook
that you are returning to me?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
所以你想借
{0}級烹飪書，是嗎？
哦，請告訴我
你要還給我的烹飪書
是什麼等級的？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There must be some
kind of mistake-- I only
lend out cookbooks from
levels 1 to 5. Hmm, well, ask
me again when you remember
which cookbook you have, okay?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
一定有什麼
誤會——我只借出
1到5級的烹飪書。嗯，好吧，
等你想起自己拿的是哪本烹飪書，
再來問我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
So you changed your mind?
It would be a good idea to
study the recipes that you
have right now before trying
something new, I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
所以你改變主意了？
我想，在嘗試新東西之前，
先好好研究一下你現在的食譜
是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Wait, wait...
Why do you want to
borrow a copy of the
cookbook that you already
have? I guess you made
some sort of mistake?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
等等，等等...
你為什麼想借一本
你已經有的烹飪書？
我想你一定是搞錯了？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Wait, wait...
Why don't you have
the book that you said
that you'd return to me?
Find it first, and then I can
lend another cookbook to you.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
等等，等等...
你為什麼沒有
你說要還給我的那本書？
先找到它，然後我
才能再借給你一本烹飪書。

scripts.text: [Charles Orleans]
scripts.translation: [查爾斯·奧爾良]

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, so you're done
with the Level 1 Cookbook.
That's good, that means you're
ready to graduate from the most
basic of basics. From now on,
the recipes will be harder...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
啊，所以你
已經看完1級烹飪書了。
很好，這意味著你
已經準備好從最基礎的
基礎畢業了。從現在開始，
食譜會變得更難...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, so what did you
think of the recipes in
the Level 2 Cookbook?
Homestyle cooking may be
simple, but it should never
be neglected by chefs.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
啊，那麼你覺得
2級烹飪書裡的食譜
怎麼樣？家常菜可能
很簡單，但廚師
絕不應該忽視它。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, done with the Level 3
Cookbook already? The recipes
in there are really good when you're cooking romantic dinners.
They'll come in handy someday,
if you know what I mean.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
啊，這麼快就看完
3級烹飪書了？裡面的食譜
在做浪漫晚餐時真的很棒。
總有一天你會用上的，
如果你明白我的意思的話。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
So you've finished the
Level 4 Cookbook. That's
no small feat! You've got to
use very strange ingredients
to create delicious cuisine!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
所以你完成了
4級烹飪書。這可不是
小事！你必須使用
非常奇怪的食材
才能做出美味的菜餚！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You're done with the
Level 5 Cookbook? Good
work: most beginners don't
even get this far. I suppose
you'll want to review some
of the easier recipes now~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
你看完
5級烹飪書了？幹得好：
大多數初學者
甚至都走不到這一步。我想
你現在想複習一些
更簡單的食譜~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Now, before I let you
borrow one of my beloved
cookbooks, I have a small
condition that you must fulfill.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
現在，在我讓你
借走我珍愛的
烹飪書之前，我有一個
小條件你必須滿足。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
When I was a young child,
my family was destitute to
the point where we live off
leftover vegetables. Even
Monster's Feed was a prime
delicacy back in those days.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
當我還是個小孩子的時候，
我的家窮到
靠吃剩菜度日。即使是
魔物飼料，在當時
也是難得的美味。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Back then, my father would
always serve us Pumpkin.
I grew sick of it as a boy, but
now it brings back memories
of those days of innocence.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
那時候，我父親
總是給我們吃南瓜。
我小時候吃膩了，
但現在它讓我想起了
那些純真的日子。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Why don't we do this?
If you bring me 10 Pumpkins,
I will let you borrow one of
my Level 1 Cookbooks.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
我們這樣怎麼樣？
如果你給我帶10個南瓜，
我就讓你借一本
我的1級烹飪書。

scripts.text: Give 10 Pumpkins and Current Cookbook
scripts.translation: 交出10個南瓜和當前烹飪書

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Perfect, you've brought
me 10 Pumpkins! I can't
want to taste these flavors
that I used to experience
everyday in my childhood.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
完美，你帶給我
10個南瓜了！我迫不及待
想嚐嚐這些味道，
它們是我小時候
每天都體驗到的。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, how I miss the
taste of Pumpkins!
Ahhh, how nostalgic~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
哦，我多麼想念
南瓜的味道！
啊，多麼懷舊~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Today, I have a craving
for a cup of tea. Of course,
you cannot enjoy tea without
crackers or cookies. Please
bring me 5 Well-Baked Cookies
to borrow my Level 2 Cookbook.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
今天，我特別想喝杯茶。
當然，喝茶不能沒有餅乾或曲奇。
請給我帶5個薑餅，
我就讓你借我的2級烹飪書。

scripts.text: Give Cookies and Current Cookbook
scripts.translation: 交出薑餅和當前烹飪書

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, you brought these
cookies much quicker
than I had expected!
Great, now I can put
the tea on, relax, then
enjoy a delicious snack~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
哦，你比我預想的還要快就帶來了這些餅乾！
太好了，現在我可以泡上茶，
放鬆一下，然後享用美味的點心~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ohh...
I must have some tea
soon... But the experience
isn't complete without any
Well-Baked Cookies to munch~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
哦...
我快得喝點茶了...
但沒有薑餅配著吃，
這體驗就不完整~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You know that specialty
dish from Amatsu? I've
been craving that lately.
Please bring me 5 Sushi,
and I'll let you borrow a
Level 3 Cookbook, okay?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
你知道櫻花城的那道特色菜嗎？
我最近一直很想吃。
請給我帶5個明蝦壽司，
我就讓你借我的3級烹飪書，好嗎？

scripts.text: Give Sushi and Current Cookbook
scripts.translation: 交出明蝦壽司和當前烹飪書

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ooh, these look so fresh!
And the presentation is also
wonderful! These must have
been prepared by a skilled chef!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
噢，這些看起來真新鮮！
擺盤也很漂亮！
這一定是位技藝高超的廚師做的！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ahhh, Sushi...
It's one of the few
things I don't know
how to make extremely
well. Can you believe that?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
啊，明蝦壽司...
這是少數幾樣
我做得不夠完美的東西之一。
你能相信嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, I'm in the mood for
some cuisine from Kunlun.
Would you bring me some of
that delicious Bao? 5 would
be perfect. Then, I'll let you
borrow my Level 4 Cookbook.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
哦，我現在想吃崑崙的料理了。
你能給我帶點那美味的包子嗎？
5個就完美了。然後，
我就讓你借我的4級烹飪書。

scripts.text: Give Bao and Current Cookbook
scripts.translation: 交出包子和當前烹飪書

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Great, you actually
brought them! These
Bao look especially
scrumptious! I can't
wait to have a taste!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
太好了，你真的帶來了！
這些包子看起來格外誘人！
我迫不及待想嚐嚐了！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh...
It's been so long
since I've had a taste
of that delicious Bao.
I'd cook it myself, but
I don't know the secret!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
哦...
我已經很久沒吃到
那美味的包子了。
我自己也能做，
但我不知道秘訣！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Lately, my pantry has been
in some dire need of Shoots.
They're a tasty ingredient with
unignorable health value. Bring
me 10 of those, and you can
borrow a Level 5 Cookbook.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
最近，我的儲藏室急需一些筍。
它們是一種美味且營養價值不容忽視的食材。
給我帶10個，
你就可以借我的5級烹飪書。

scripts.text: Give Shoots and Current Cookbook
scripts.translation: 交出筍和當前烹飪書

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Goodness, these are
some high quality Shoots!
These look so good, I'm
sure that you you can
even eat them raw!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
天哪，這些筍質量真高！
看起來這麼好吃，
我敢肯定你甚至可以直接生吃！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I'm going to need to
cook with those Shoots
soon, so I'd appreciate it
if you'd do this little favor~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
我很快就要用這些筍做飯了，
所以如果你能幫這個小忙，
我會很感激的~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Well, as promised,
here's the cookbook
that you asked for. Take
good care of it--don't sell
it or lose it or anything like
that. Good luck cooking now~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
好了，如你所願，
這是你要的烹飪書。
請好好保管——
不要賣掉或弄丟之類的。
祝你烹飪順利~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
What do you mean,
''Who do I cook for?''
That's a strange question
with a simple answer. I'm
an artiste that must bring
more of my art into the world.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
你什麼意思，
“我為誰做飯？”
這是個奇怪的問題，
但答案很簡單。
我是一個藝術家，
必須將更多的藝術帶入世界。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Wait, wait...
Have you been speaking
to Madeleine Chu? She
didn't say anything out
of the ordinary did she?
Because if she did, ignore her!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
等等，等等...
你是在和瑪德琳·朱說話嗎？
她沒說什麼奇怪的話吧？
因為如果她說了，請忽略她！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
No. There is
no special reason
why my spirit to create
culinary masterpieces has
been reinvigorated lately...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
不。
我最近創作烹飪傑作的
熱情重新燃起，
並沒有特殊的原因...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Please, do not worry
yourself about it. Just
let me rest for now~
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
請別擔心。
現在讓我先休息一下~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Mon dieu!
An error has
occurred!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
天哪！
發生錯誤了！

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I'm sorry, but right now
you're carrying too many
items. You should put your
extra things in Kafra Storage,
and then talk to me again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
抱歉，您現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請把多餘的東西存入卡普拉倉庫，
然後再來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, hello~
I'm Madeleine Chu,
chef apprentice to
Sir Charles. May I help
you with anything today?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦，你好~
我是瑪德琳·朱，
查爾斯·奧爾良先生的廚師學徒。
今天有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: What do you do as a chef?
scripts.translation: 作為廚師，你是做什麼的？

scripts.text: Which foods can you make?
scripts.translation: 你會做哪些食物？

scripts.text: I want to learn cooking too!
scripts.translation: 我也想學做飯！

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
What do I do as a chef?
Well, I'm just an apprentice now, so I'm still learning how to cook.
But someday, I want to become
a great chef and have everybody
recognize my culinary talents~
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
作為廚師，我做什麼呢？
嗯，我現在只是個學徒，所以還在學做飯。
但總有一天，我想成為一名偉大的廚師，
讓所有人都認可我的烹飪才華~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
There's a lot of grueling
work that goes into cooking,
as well as a lot of finesse.
I have to control fire better
tham a firefighter and craft
my dishes like an artist.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
烹飪需要大量的艱苦工作，
也需要很多技巧。
我必須比消防員更擅長控制火候，
像藝術家一樣創作我的菜餚。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Well, I'm exaggerating
a little bit, but cooking
at a certain level is much
more difficult than it appears.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
嗯，我有點誇張了，
但達到一定水平的烹飪
比看起來要難得多。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Well, I only know the basic
recipes for now. Sir Charles
says that even the best chef
knows how to bring out the
flavors of even common foods.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
嗯，我現在只知道基礎食譜。
查爾斯·奧爾良先生說，
即使是最好的廚師，
也能從普通食物中激發出美味。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
He says that I need to develop
my culinary skills until I can
learn more advanced recipes.
Someday, I'll advance and then
I'll know enough to create my
own unique, delicious dishes!
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
他說我需要磨練烹飪技巧，
直到能學習更高階的食譜。
總有一天，我會進階，
然後就能創造出
屬於我自己的獨特美味佳餚！

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Sir Charles may be harsh to
his students, but his skills
are unequaled. I tried one of
his desserts once, and it was
the most heavenly experience.
I swear I saw winged hearts~!
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
查爾斯·奧爾良先生對學生可能很嚴厲，
但他的技藝無人能及。
我嘗過他的一道甜點，
那是最天堂般的體驗。
我發誓我看到了長著翅膀的心~！

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Sadly, I'm a still long way
from learning how to make 
his specialty, Handmade
Chocolates. Before that, I need
to master these strange recipes
that he keeps teaching me...
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
遺憾的是，我離學會製作
他的招牌菜——手工巧克力
還有很長的路要走。
在那之前，我需要掌握
他一直教我的那些奇怪食譜...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
If you want to learn cooking,
why don't you ask Sir Charles?
He's fairly harsh to his students, but he does it out of tough love.
He demands nothing less than
absolute perfection, you know.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
如果你想學做飯，
為什麼不問問查爾斯·奧爾良先生呢？
他對學生相當嚴厲，但那是出於嚴格的愛。
他要求絕對的完美，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
If you manage to get
Sir Charles to teach you
a recipe, you should practice
it over and over again to hone
your skills. Then, you'll find
yourself improving at cooking.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
如果你能讓查爾斯·奧爾良先生
教你一道食譜，
你應該反覆練習以磨練技巧。
然後，你會發現自己的烹飪技術在進步。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Now, Sir Charles will only
teach students that are truly
committed to cooking. You
might want to show your
dedication with the proper
attire... like a Chef Hat.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
現在，查爾斯·奧爾良先生
只會教那些真正致力於烹飪的學生。
你可能需要用合適的服裝
來展示你的決心...比如廚師帽。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
But yes, Sir Charles
has very little patience for
beginners, meaning that
you'll have to be patient
with his teaching methods...
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
但是是的，查爾斯·奧爾良先生
對初學者幾乎沒有耐心，
這意味著你必須對他的教學方法
保持耐心...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Hello, is there any
way I can help you today?
Oh, if you're studying cooking
under Sir Charles, I can remind
you of the ingredients you need
if you've forgotten them~
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
你好，今天有什麼
我可以幫你的嗎？
哦，如果你正在查爾斯·奧爾良先生
門下學習烹飪，如果你忘記了
所需的食材，我可以提醒你~

scripts.text: Fried Grasshopper Legs
scripts.translation: 油炸螞蚱

scripts.text: Grape Juice Herbal Tea
scripts.translation: 葡萄汁藥草茶

scripts.text: Honey Grape Juice
scripts.translation: 蜂蜜葡萄汁

scripts.text: Frog Egg and Squid Ink Soup
scripts.translation: 蛙卵墨汁湯

scripts.text: Steamed Crab Nippers
scripts.translation: 蒸蟹螯

scripts.text: Fried Monkey Tails
scripts.translation: 熱炒猴尾巴

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh! You'll need
^4D4DFF5 Grasshopper Legs^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Cooking Oil^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Old Frying Pan^000000 to make
fried Grasshopper Legs.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦！製作油炸螞蚱需要
^4D4DFF5螞蚱腿^000000、
^4D4DFF1食用油^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1破舊平底鍋^000000。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh! You'll need
^4D4DFF3 Grapes^000000, and
^4D4DFF2 Red Potions^000000 for
Grape Juice Herbal Tea.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦！製作葡萄汁藥草茶需要
^4D4DFF3葡萄^000000，以及
^4D4DFF2紅色藥水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh! You'll need
^4D4DFF1 Honey^000000,
^4D4DFF2 Grapes^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Red Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦！製作蜂蜜葡萄汁需要
^4D4DFF1蜂蜜^000000、
^4D4DFF2葡萄^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1紅色藥水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh! You'll need
^4D4DFF1 Bag of Grain^000000,
^4D4DFF10 Spawns^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Squid Ink^000000 for Frog
Egg and Squid Ink soup.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦！製作蛙卵墨汁湯需要
^4D4DFF1穀物袋^000000、
^4D4DFF10蛙卵^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1墨汁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh! You'll need
^4D4DFF10 Green Herbs^000000,
^4D4DFF10 Nippers^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Potion^000000 for
Steamed Crab Nippers.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦！製作蒸蟹螯需要
^4D4DFF10綠色藥草^000000、
^4D4DFF10蟹螯^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1黃色藥水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh! You'll need
^4D4DFF1 Frying Pan^000000,
^4D4DFF5 Yoyo Tails^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Cooking Oil^000000 for
Fried Monkey Tails.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦！製作熱炒猴尾巴需要
^4D4DFF1平底鍋^000000、
^4D4DFF5溜溜猴尾巴^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1食用油^000000。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I know that Sir Charles
is stubborn and won't tell
you the ingredients again
if you forget. Anyway, I hope
you collect them and complete
the recipe as soon as you can~
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
我知道查爾斯·奧爾良先生很固執，如果你忘記了，他是不會再次告訴你食材的。總之，希望你能儘快收集齊食材並完成食譜~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Sir Charles taught you
a recipe? That's great!
I hope you remember that the
quality of your dishes mostly
relies on your skills, so always remember to keep practicing.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
查爾斯·奧爾良先生教了你一道食譜？太棒了！
我希望你記住，菜餚的品質主要取決於你的技巧，所以請記得一直練習。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Ah, you know what might
help you improve your
culinary skills? Why don't
you borrow this cookbook
and try some of its recipes?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
啊，你知道什麼能幫助你提升烹飪技巧嗎？
何不借這本食譜，嘗試一下里面的食譜呢？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Before you cook, make sure
that you have enough of the
ingredients. Oh, and keep the
cookbook nearby while you are
cooking. You'll probably need
to refer to it pretty often...
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
在烹飪之前，請確保你有足夠的食材。
哦，烹飪時請把食譜放在手邊。你可能經常需要查閱它...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
You might fail to make
edible food during your
first attempts, but you'll
improve as you practice. 
Please take this cookbook
with the basic Level 1 recipes.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
在最初的嘗試中，你可能無法做出可食用的食物，但你會隨著練習而進步。
請收下這本包含基礎1級食譜的食譜。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Once you learn all the recipes,
feel free to come back to me for more, okay? Also, you'll need
these cooking kits to practice.
You can have these for free, and you can buy more from me later~
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
一旦你學會了所有食譜，隨時可以回來找我獲取更多，好嗎？
此外，你需要這些烹飪工具來練習。
這些可以免費給你，之後你可以從我這裡購買更多~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
So how has your cooking
been coming along? You'll
need to practice to develop
your culinary skills. Now,
can I help you with anything?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
那麼，你的烹飪進展如何？
你需要練習來提升烹飪技巧。
現在，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: I need some Cooking Kits.
scripts.translation: 我需要一些烹飪工具

scripts.text: Will you try the food I cooked?
scripts.translation: 你要嚐嚐我做的食物嗎？

scripts.text: How does the food I cooked look?
scripts.translation: 嚐嚐我做的食物

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Sure, which kind
of Cooking Kits
did you need?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
當然可以，你需要哪種烹飪用具呢？

scripts.text: Outdoor Cooking Kit - 500z
scripts.translation: 野外烹飪用具 - 500z

scripts.text: Home Cooking Kit - 1,000z
scripts.translation: 家庭烹飪用具 - 1,000z

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough skills
to use a Home Cooking Kit.
Please practice some more
with the Outdoor Cooking
Kits first, alright?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦，抱歉，你的技能等級還不夠使用家庭烹飪用具。
請先多練習一下野外烹飪用具，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Please come back and
let me know if you need
to purchase any Cooking
Kits, alright? See you later~
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
如果需要購買烹飪用具，請隨時回來找我，好嗎？再見~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, you've made a sample
of every recipe detailed in
that basic cookbook, did you?
That must have been very good training for your culinary skills.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦，你已經把那本基礎食譜裡的每道菜都試做了一遍，是嗎？
這對你的烹飪技巧來說是很好的訓練。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I'd love to taste your
food and give my opinion,
but do you mind if I ask
you a favor first? I have
a friend in Payon who used
to study cooking in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
我很想嚐嚐你的食物並給出評價，
但能先請你幫個忙嗎？我在斐揚有個朋友，
他以前在普隆德拉學過烹飪。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
However, he became frustrated
with the culinary classes and
moved back to Prontera. Would
you mind asking him to taste
them? Here, I'll wrap your
food in this handy cloth...
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
不過，他對烹飪課感到沮喪，
於是搬回了普隆德拉。你介意請他嚐嚐嗎？
來，我用這塊方便的手帕幫你包好食物...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
There you go, it's ready
to be delivered. Now, make
sure not to open this before
giving it to my old friend,
Chulsoo. You can find him
somewhere around Payon...
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
好了，可以送出去了。現在，
在交給我的老朋友哲秀之前，
千萬不要開啟哦。你可以在斐揚附近找到他...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
You should be able to
find Chulsoo around the
water mill or the pub in
Payon. Oh, and don't
forget to tell him that
I sent you, okay? Thanks~
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
你應該能在斐揚的水磨坊或酒館附近找到哲秀。
哦，別忘了告訴他是我派你來的，好嗎？謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Hmm... I think it'd
be better if you tried
to make every recipe in
that basic cookbook I gave
you first. That way, I can more
accurately judge your skills.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
嗯...我覺得最好先試著做一遍我給你的那本基礎食譜裡的所有菜。
這樣，我才能更準確地判斷你的水平。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
It's not bad to focus
on just one recipe, but
as a beginner, you need
to cover all of the basics.
Please read the cookbook that I gave you very carefully, okay?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
只專注於一道菜也不錯，
但作為初學者，你需要掌握所有基礎。
請仔細閱讀我給你的食譜，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, I see that you've
tried some recipes in that
basic cookbook that I gave
you. Everything you made looks
delicious. All that's left now
is for someone to taste it...
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦，看來你已經嘗試了我給你的那本基礎食譜裡的一些菜。
你做的每道菜看起來都很美味。現在只差有人來嚐嚐了...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Well... I don't know...
I think you really should try
to make every recipe listed
in that basic cookbook that
I gave to you first. Then, you
can present your dishes~
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
嗯...我不確定...
我覺得你真的應該先試著做一遍我給你的那本基礎食譜裡的所有菜。
然後，你就可以展示你的廚藝了~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Please find my friend
Chulsoo in Payon and
give him the Bundle of
Food so that he can taste
the dishes you've made.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
請去斐揚找到我的朋友哲秀，
把食物保鮮袋交給他，讓他嚐嚐你做的菜。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Ah, hello~ oh, will you give me a second?
Right now, I am frying something so, I need to focus on this work for a while.
Hahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
啊，你好~ 哦，能給我一點時間嗎？
我現在正在煎東西，需要專心一會兒。
哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, so have you met
my friend Chulsoo?
You brought him the
Bundle of Food, right?
I'd be disappointed if
you lost it or sold it...
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦，那你見過我的朋友哲秀了嗎？
你把食物保鮮袋帶給他了，對吧？
如果你弄丟了或者賣掉了，我會很失望的...

scripts.text: I did!
scripts.translation: 我做到了！

scripts.text: I lost the Bundle of Food!
scripts.translation: 我弄丟了食物保鮮袋！

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Hahaha, I suppose you
did. But even if you didn't
yet, make sure that you do
it soon, alright? See you~
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哈哈，我相信你做到了。
不過即使你還沒做，
也請快點去辦，好嗎？再見~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
You lost it? Oh, that's
not good. How can you 
disrespect the culinary
arts in that way? I'm so
very ashamed of you...
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
你弄丟了？哎呀，這可不好。
怎麼能這樣不尊重烹飪藝術呢？
我真為你感到羞愧...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
First of all, I'd like
you to return my cookbook.
I want you to reflect on what
you've done, and then learn
cooking skills from Sir Charles, starting from the very beginning.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
首先，我希望你把我的食譜還給我。
我想讓你反思一下你所做的事，
然後從查爾斯爵士那裡重新學習烹飪技巧，從頭開始。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, you must be joking~
I'm sure you must have
hidden it somewhere.
Anyway, please deliver that
Bundle of Food to Chulsoo.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦，你一定是在開玩笑吧~
我敢肯定你把它藏在某個地方了。
總之，請把食物保鮮袋交給哲秀。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I just received a
message from Chulsoo
thanking me for having
you send him that food.
I'm guessing that he
really liked it a lot.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
我剛收到哲秀的來信，
感謝我把食物送給他。
我猜他一定非常喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I think you're ready to use
higher grade cooking tools now.
But never forget that your own
skills are the most important
factor in quality cuisine.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
我想你現在可以使用更高階的烹飪用具了。
但永遠不要忘記，
你自己的技巧才是決定美食質量的最重要因素。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Please try these Indoor
Cooking Kits to help you
create more delicate dishes.
When you run out, feel free to
purchase more from me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
請試試這些室內烹飪用具，
它們能幫助你製作更精緻的菜餚。
用完之後，隨時可以向我購買更多，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Also, if you want to
learn some new recipes,
why don't you talk to Sir
Charles again? Okay then,
good luck, and I'll see you later~
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
另外，如果你想學一些新食譜，
為什麼不再去和查爾斯爵士談談呢？
好了，祝你好運，回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
How are you? I hope
that you've been honing
your cooking skills since
the last time we've met.
Now, can I help you with
anything in particular?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
你好嗎？我希望
自上次見面以來，
你一直在磨練你的烹飪技巧。
現在，有什麼我可以特別幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: I need some Cooking Kits.
scripts.translation: 我需要一些烹飪工具

scripts.text: How is Sir Charles?
scripts.translation: 查爾斯爵士怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: Um, who's that kid?
scripts.translation: 那個小孩是誰？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Sure, which kind
of Cooking Kits
did you need?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
當然可以，你需要哪種烹飪用具呢？

scripts.text: Outdoor Cooking Kit - 500z
scripts.translation: 野外烹飪用具 - 500z

scripts.text: Home Cooking Kit - 1,000z
scripts.translation: 家庭烹飪用具 - 1,000z

scripts.text: Show me a different kit.
scripts.translation: 給我看看別的用具。

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Well, I only have two
types of cooking kits,
although there is a superior
Professional Cooking Kit that
real experts, like Sir Charles,
use. Amazing, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
嗯，我只有兩種烹飪用具，
不過還有一種更高階的高階烹飪用具，
像查爾斯爵士這樣的真正專家會使用它。
真厲害，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
You're still a beginner, so
my kits will serve you well. 
You know, there's a rumor about a cooking kit that can perfectly
make any recipe, so long as all of the ingredients are provided.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
你還是個初學者，
所以我的用具很適合你。
你知道嗎，有個傳聞說有一種烹飪用具，
只要提供所有食材，就能完美地做出任何食譜。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Of course, it's only
a rumor, probably just
the result of someone's
weird imagination. I still
believe skill is the most
important ingredient~
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
當然，那只是個傳聞，
可能只是某人奇怪的想像。
我仍然相信技巧是最重要的食材~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Please come back and
let me know if you need
to purchase any Cooking
Kits, alright? See you later~
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
如果需要購買烹飪用具，請隨時回來找我，好嗎？再見~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Hm? Sir Charles is
fine, but lately he's been
getting a little upset at
even small things. Still,
I guess it's understandable.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
嗯？查爾斯爵士沒事，
但最近他因為一些小事
有點不高興。不過，
我想這也是可以理解的。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
You know, when I first
met him, I assumed he was
only good at cooking sweets
like chocolates and caramels.
However, he is highly skilled
at cooking almost everything!
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
你知道嗎，當我第一次見到他時，
我以為他只擅長做巧克力和糖果之類的甜點。
然而，他幾乎擅長烹飪所有東西！

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I suppose he's been focusing
on foods other than desserts
ever since our king disappeared. I wonder if King Tristram III's
disappearance is related to Sir
Charles's change in mood?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
我想自從我們的國王失蹤後，
他就一直專注於甜點以外的食物。
我想知道國王特里斯坦三世的失蹤
是否與查爾斯爵士的情緒變化有關？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I mean, Sir Charles seems
to be the type that has trouble
opening up to other people.
That may explain why he's much
nicer to women than to men.
Doesn't that make sense?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
我的意思是，查爾斯爵士似乎
是那種很難向別人敞開心扉的人。
這可能解釋了他為什麼對女性比對男性更友善。
這說得通嗎？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Maybe it's because he's
been experimenting with
a new recipe lately. I think he
mentioned something about
wanting to treat some woman
to the finest food ever made.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
也許是因為他最近一直在
嘗試新的食譜。我想他提到過
想請一位女士品嚐有史以來最美味的食物。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I've never seen Sir Charles
so excited before. That woman
must be very lucky: she has the
chance to eat his cooking every
day if she wanted! I'm almost
jealous of her, you know that?
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
我從未見過查爾斯爵士如此興奮過。
那位女士一定非常幸運：
如果她願意，她每天都能吃到他做的菜！
說實話，我都有點嫉妒她了。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, you mean the
child with the cat?
I'm not sure, but I think
I overheard that she might
be the younger sister of
Madam Wickebine.
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
哦，你是說那個抱貓的孩子嗎？

她可能是維克貝恩夫人的妹妹。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I wonder why Sir Charles
gives Madam Wickebine such
special treatment. Whenever
I ask him about it, he gets so
upset and doesn't say anything!
scripts.translation:
[瑪德琳·朱]
我想知道為什麼查爾斯爵士
對維克貝恩夫人如此特別。
每次我問起這件事，
他都會很生氣，什麼都不肯說！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Mince alors!
I just felt a chill down my
spine... Could someone
be talking about me?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯·奧爾良]
天哪！
我剛才突然感到一陣寒意...
難道有人在談論我嗎？

scripts.text:

Error occurred.
scripts.translation:

發生錯誤。

Cooking Kits would
you like to buy? If you

您想購買多少份{0}烹飪套裝？

{0}...

your culinary training!
scripts.translation:

your stuff in Kafra Storage

先把一些東西存入卡普拉倉庫呢？

scripts.text:

When you get the chance,
please give Madeline my
thanks. I'll visit Prontera
soon to see her, as well as
make amends with Sir Charles.
scripts.translation:

如果有機會，請代我向瑪德琳致謝。
我很快會去普隆德拉看她，
也會去和查爾斯爵士和解。

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
How would you like
to buy a Rice Cake?

it's oh-so-delicious~
scripts.translation:

你想買一塊Q彈的長條糕嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, I'll buy one!
scripts.translation: 好的，我要買一塊！

scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

money to buy a Rice Cake...

[哲秀]
非常感謝！

scripts.text:

that? You won't get
the chance to have a
Rice Cake this delicious
anywhere else. Oh well,
that means more for me~
scripts.translation:

你確定嗎？
別處可吃不到這麼美味的Q彈的長條糕哦。
算了，那正好留給我吃~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, Madeleine
sent me here to find
you. She said that you'd
be willing to taste test
the food in this bundle...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，是瑪德琳派我
來找您的。
她說您願意品嚐
這個食物保鮮袋裡的食物...

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Madeleine? You mean
Madeleine Chu? Oh, I haven't
heard from her in such a long
time! Great, let me see the
bundle that she sent me. Ah, everything here looks appetizing!
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
瑪德琳？你是說
瑪德琳·朱？
好久沒聽到她的訊息了！
太好了，讓我看看
她寄來的食物保鮮袋。
啊，裡面的東西看起來都很誘人！

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Oh, wait. She even
included a message
inside this bundle.
Let's see, here...
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
哦，等等。
這個食物保鮮袋裡
還有一封信。
讓我看看，這裡...

scripts.text:
^333333Dear Chulsoo,
 It's been a long time.
I know you left Prontera on
bad terms with Sir Charles,
but please understand that
he was only trying his best to
help improve your cooking.^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333親愛的哲秀：
好久不見。
我知道你和查爾斯爵士
鬧得很不愉快才離開普隆德拉，
但請理解，
他只是想盡力幫助你
提升廚藝。^000000

scripts.text:
^333333 Sir Charles always wished
that you'd expand your repetoire, and that you'd make these kinds
of foods someday. The person
that delivered this food also
cooked it. Please try it...^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333查爾斯爵士一直希望
你能拓展你的食譜，
並期待你有一天能做出
這樣的食物。
送這份食物的人
也親自烹飪了它。
請嚐嚐看...^000000

scripts.text:
^333333 Hopefully, you'll be
able to understand Sir 
Charles a little better 
after tasting this food.
 
 Your friend, Madeleine^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333希望你在品嚐了
這些食物後，
能更理解查爾斯爵士一些。

你的朋友，瑪德琳^000000

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Now I get it...
These are the recipes
that Sir Charles tried
to teach me. But I refused
to learn them because I had
thought they were too gross...
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
原來如此...
這些就是查爾斯爵士
試圖教我的食譜。
但我當時拒絕了，
因為我覺得它們太噁心了...

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
......
.........
It's so delicious... Are
you sure you're just a
beginner? No... This must
be what I've been missing...
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
......
.........
真好吃...
你確定你只是個初學者嗎？
不...這一定是我
一直缺失的東西...

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
It's what my master
always tried to teach me,
but I was too impatient to
properly learn it. The greatest
ingredient of them all... ^D02090heart^000000. After all this time, I understand.
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
這就是我的師父
一直試圖教給我的，
但我當時太急躁，
沒能好好學會。
最重要的食材...
^D02090心^000000。
過了這麼久，我終於明白了。

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Thank you for bringing
this food to me. I will enjoy
it thoroughly, and reflect upon
what my old teacher was trying
to tell me. In return, please have one of my humble Rice Cakes.
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
謝謝你把這些食物帶給我。
我會好好享用，
並反思我的老師
想告訴我的道理。
作為回報，
請嚐嚐我做的Q彈的長條糕。

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
I better visit Prontera
again soon. It's been a long
time since I've seen Madeleine.
More importantly, I think that
I should apologize to Sir Charles.
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
我最好儘快再去一趟普隆德拉。
好久沒見瑪德琳了。
更重要的是，
我覺得我應該向查爾斯爵士道歉。

sent me here to find
you. She said that you'd
be willing to taste test
the food in this bundle...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，是瑪德琳派我
來找您的。
她說您願意品嚐
這個食物保鮮袋裡的食物...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, wait...
I don't have it!
Where did I put
that Bundle of Food?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，等等...
我沒帶！
我把那個食物保鮮袋
放哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Lately, it seems that
no one wants to buy my
Rice Cakes. It's been like
that ever since I left Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
最近，似乎沒人
願意買我的Q彈的長條糕了。
自從我離開普隆德拉以來
一直如此...

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
You see, I used to study
in that city as one of Sir
Charles's apprentices. It
was only a few months, but
I was very excited to get the
chance to learn under him.
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
你看，我曾經
在那座城市學習，
是查爾斯爵士的學徒之一。
雖然只有幾個月，
但我當時非常興奮，
能有機會在他門下學習。

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
At least, I was excited
at first. Sir Charles really
frustrated me: he would
only teach me to make these
really gross sounding recipes! Like Grasshopper Legs and-- ugh!
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
至少，一開始我很興奮。
查爾斯爵士真讓我沮喪：
他只教我做那些
聽起來很噁心的食譜！
比如蚱蜢腿，還有-- 唉！

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
He kept insisting that
I was forgetting the most
important ingredient, and that
it was possible to make things
like Fried Monkey Tails delicious. But I can't believe that nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
他堅持認為我
忘記了最重要的食材，
並且認為像熱炒猴尾巴
這樣的東西也能做得美味。
但我無法相信這種胡話！

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
In the end, I ran away.
For some reason, I feel
a little ashamed and regret
what I did. Still, I don't see
what Sir Charles meant...
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
最後，我逃跑了。
不知為何，我現在
感到有點羞愧和後悔。
但我還是不明白
查爾斯爵士的意思...
